source_snapshots.title: Dell Technologies Fourth Quarter and Full-Year Fiscal 2026 Results
source_snapshots.locator: PDF pages 1-2; headline paragraph and Operating Segments Results table
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: FY26: more than USD64bn AI-optimized server orders, more than USD25bn shipped, USD43bn ending backlog; Q4 AI-optimized server revenue USD8,952m; FY26 USD24,683m; Q4 ISG revenue USD19,602m and operating income USD2,900m; FY26 ISG revenue USD60,826m and operating income USD7,111m.

source_snapshots.title: Dell Technologies First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Earnings Exhibit
source_snapshots.locator: PDF pages 1 and 4; summary and Segment Information table
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: Q1 FY27: USD24.4bn AI orders and USD16.1bn AI server revenue; AI-optimized server revenue USD16,132m; total ISG revenue USD29,009m; ISG operating income USD3,055m and margin 10.5%; company revenue USD43,842m, operating income USD3,656m and cash from operating activities USD4,081m.

source_snapshots.title: DELL Q1 2027 Earnings Call
source_snapshots.locator: prepared remarks, Q1 AI demand paragraph
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: Q1 FY27 AI orders USD24.4bn, AI server revenue USD16.1bn, ending AI backlog USD51.3bn; demand exceeded supply with memory described as the primary constraint; customer count surpassed 5,000 across neocloud, sovereign and enterprise.

source_snapshots.title: Dell Technologies Form 10-Q for quarter ended May 1, 2026
source_snapshots.locator: Statements of Financial Position lines 167-194; Cash Flows lines 309-336; ISG table lines 2267-2290
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: At May 1, 2026: accounts receivable USD25,854m, inventories USD15,052m, accounts payable USD45,261m. At January 30, 2026: USD17,585m, USD10,437m, USD33,630m respectively. Q1 cash from operations USD4,081m; capex and capitalized software USD963m; free cash flow USD3,118m. AI-optimized server revenue USD16,132m; ISG revenue USD29,009m and operating income USD3,055m.

source_snapshots.title: Dell Technologies Form 10-K for fiscal year ended January 30, 2026
source_snapshots.locator: MD&A lines 1170-1202 and ISG discussion lines 1328-1335
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: Dell reports inherent non-linearity between AI demand and shipments, a lower gross margin rate from mix shifting toward AI-optimized servers, and working-capital effects including higher inventory, receivables and payables.

source_snapshots.title: Dell PowerEdge XE9712 product page
source_snapshots.locator: technical specifications: accelerator, memory, power and cooling
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: PowerEdge XE9712 is a rack-scale AI system; the current product page describes Blackwell accelerators, NVLink CPU-GPU interconnect, HBM3e, IR9048 power shelf and direct liquid cooling.

source_snapshots.title: CoreWeave and Dell Technologies Extend Relationship to Deliver AI at Scale
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: Dell disclosed first shipment of liquid-cooled PowerEdge XE9712 racks with NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 to CoreWeave, integrated in Dell IR7000 racks with Dell professional services.

source_snapshots.title: Dell PowerEdge XE9712 Installation and Service Manual
source_snapshots.locator: system configuration and technical specifications navigation
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: Dell support manual identifies the PowerEdge XE9712 system configuration and technical specification sections.

source_snapshots.title: Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA Advances HPC and AI Infrastructure
source_snapshots.normalized_extract: Dell disclosed that Monash University's MAVERIC system uses liquid-cooled Dell PowerRack systems with PowerEdge XE9712 servers and NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 architecture.

evidence_rows.claim_boundary: Supports a company-bound counterevidence mechanism; does not quantify AI-server product margin or cancellation risk.
